name: Shroomer - Demo
summary:
In this open world VR fantasy,  you take on the role of Shroomer - a mystical mushroom forager, entrusted by the kingdom to manage a secret enchanted forest.

Your mission is to gather rare and powerful fungi and vegetation, process them into useful elixirs, and fulfill tasks for the kingdom and its people. However, the forest is full of danger—some mushrooms are not just poisonous but volatile, capable of exploding, releasing toxic spores, or reacting unpredictably.
